input:
During 4K video recording to internal eMMC, we observe two simultaneous failures: (1) MediaRecorder reports a dropped frame approximately every 45 seconds, and (2) the system freezes completely about 3 minutes into recording and requires a hard reboot. The dmesg captured before freeze shows:

  [  183.441] mmc0: Timeout waiting for hardware interrupt
  [  183.442] mmc0: CMD25 response timeout after 2000ms
  [  183.443] mmc0: reset controller: SDHCI_RESET_ALL
  [  183.451] mtk-mmc mmc0: mmc_request_done: CMD25 ETIMEDOUT
  [  183.452] f2fs: write_cache_pages: writeback error -110
  [  183.453] f2fs: checkpoint failed: -110
  [  183.458] watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 26s! [kworker:2]

The eMMC is a Samsung KLUCG8UHDB-B0E1 (256 GB UFS-2.1 mis-labeled as eMMC in our BSP — actually UFS). The CMD25 timeout suggests the device is busy during a background garbage collection or a cache flush. How do I determine whether this is a UFS device-side issue (GC timing) or a host controller driver bug, and why would a write stall cause the watchdog to fire?
